description: List supported actions for macros in Zendesk. Use when you need to discover what field modifications are available when creating or editing macros. This endpoint returns the available action fields that can be set in a macro (e.g., status, priority, assignee, etc.) along with their possible values. This is useful for validating macro configurations or building macro management interfaces. This action is read-only and idempotent.
